facts.value: The exchange programs of the department are announced once a year. The application for a specific program or university is based on the respective announcement on the internet. Please refer to the application requirements and application documents in the relevant announcement.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For the European and worldwide programs, there are separate application procedures. The announcement and selection for the worldwide programs takes place before the selection for the European programs. If your application for a worldwide program is unsuccessful, an application for the European exchange within the Erasmus+ Program is possible without restriction.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The announcements and selection for the worldwide and European exchanges occur simultaneously. The announcements are published at the end of October with an application deadline of February 1 of the following year.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
